artifacts.synopsis: Philadelphia Presbytery declared Reese and Bech's complaint out of order because some supporting reasons and requested amends allegedly violated the BCO. The SJC sustained the complaint, holding Presbytery misapplied Robert's Rules: objectionable parts do not justify rejecting an entire complaint, and a court need not adopt requested amends. It also said pertinent questions about whether a call is for the good of the Church may be asked, but agreed the amends—including removing TE Hsu—were inappropriate and could not rescind his installation.
